title: White-to-Black median family net worth ratio, by SCF wave
cap: Median net worth of white non-Hispanic families divided by that of Black non-Hispanic families, Federal Reserve Survey of Consumer Finances; 1989-2019 medians as published by EPI from the Fed's SCF tables, 2022 and 2025 from the Fed's 2025 SCF bulletin (race of respondent). Ratios are book arithmetic; small Black subsamples make single-wave changes imprecise.
